YouTube Video Editor and Downloader — version 1.0.0 (initial release)

- Launches an AI-powered tool for downloading, editing, and exporting YouTube and video files up to 500MB.
- Supports MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI, and more. Describe your edit (e.g., "trim to 2 minutes with transitions") for fast results.
- Simple onboarding: uses NEMO_TOKEN if available or auto-acquires a free trial token.
- Guides users through session creation and common edit/export workflows.
- Clearly documents error handling, accepted formats, and how to get help or check export status.
